description: Fuzzy search across approved symbols, names, and aliases — e.g. "breast cancer", "p53", "tumor protein". Returns lightweight matches (hgnc_id, symbol, relevance score) ranked by score; call get_gene with a returned symbol for the full record. Keyless.

query.description: Gene symbol, name fragment, or alias, e.g. "breast cancer", "p53", "kinase".

name: hgnc_search_genes
title: Hgnc Search Genes
